run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the k-th distinct non-repeating element in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds the k-th unique element by scanning for non-repeating values
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a hash map instead of O(n^2) nested loops for better performance
